question:
**Select the correct pair of words for the blanks in the given sentence.**

My teacher asked me to read ______ and also ______ my best friend to celebrate his birthday in the school.
solution:
The correct answer is '**aloud; allowed**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• '**Aloud**' means '**out loud**' or in a voice audible to others. (उच्च स्वर में or जोर से)
 
• In the sentence, &
